integrity: Analytical finite-dimensional proof with directly reconstructed finite checks; all-power statements are analytic, not inferred by sampling. Sharpness is instantaneous, not fixed-positive-time.
scientific_limitations: Finite, unweighted complete multipartite graphs, unit vertex masses, real-valued signals, one-input edge-Lipschitz gradients and \(1<p<\infty\). Linear special case and clique/star restrictions are not standalone novelty; no arbitrary weights, infinity graphs, or two-input Lipschitz estimates. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp one-input gradient dissipation for nonlinear heat on complete multipartite graphs
